The trunk.

Shared tools for different product needs. Each package page explains what it does, how it works, where to get it, and which apps list it as a dependency. Some are new and have no adopters yet.

Browse shared tools by the jobs they do across the studio.

ai-kitThinknpm v1.11.014 apps
Which model to call, whether the vendor still serves it, and what to do when every one of them fails.
ai-formsThinknpm v0.1.26 apps
Fill a form from prose, then refine it in conversation. Headless, so every app keeps its own look.
mail-kitReach someonenpm v0.1.111 apps
One email layer for every app. Never throws — it returns whether the mail was sent.
threadkitReach someonenpm v0.1.14 apps
Message threads where permission is participation — not a role column. An AI obeys the same rules as a person.
bip-kitShow the worknpm v0.3.110 apps
Blog, roadmap and changelog from repo-authored markdown. Typed blocks, your design tokens on top.
listkitShow the workgit v0.1.04 apps
A list as a query: facets, a URL you can share, sorting that puts missing values last. No markup.
design-tokensShow the worknpm v1.1.03 apps
One tokens.css behind the products, so a retheme is an edit to one file.
sitekitShow the worknpm v0.3.02 apps
A website as data — a closed set of section shapes, validated, with per-field provenance.
limitkitStay upnpm v0.2.08 apps
Rate limiting as a decision, not middleware. Bounded memory by construction, standard headers.
paykitGet paidnpm v0.1.00 apps
Classify pasted Bitcoin receive strings and describe payment rails a site can show. It does not hold keys or verify settlement.
